# cycle_network (Resource)

Manages a Cycle SDN network (`/v1/sdn/networks`). `cluster` and `identifier` cannot be changed in place. `name` updates via `PATCH`; `acl` updates via the access endpoint; `environment_ids` updates via a `reconfigure` job.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# An SDN network that can attach environments in the same cluster.
resource "cycle_network" "shared" {
  name       = "shared"
  identifier = "shared"
  cluster    = "production"

  environment_ids = [
    cycle_environment.api.id,
    cycle_environment.worker.id,
  ]

  # Optional ACL: role ID → view / modify / manage.
  acl = jsonencode({
    roles = {
      "651efd54c53f7b6e2c5a9f00" = {
        view   = true
        modify = false
        manage = false
      }
    }
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster` (String) The identifier of the cluster whose environments may join this network. Changing this forces a new network to be created.
- `identifier` (String) A network identifier used to construct HTTP calls that specifically use this network. Changing this forces a new network to be created.
- `name` (String) A user-defined name for the network.

### Optional

- `acl` (String) Network ACL as a JSON object (`{ "roles": { "<role-id>": { "view": bool, "modify": bool, "manage": bool } } }`).
- `environment_ids` (Set of String) Environment IDs attached to this network. Defaults to an empty set. Changing membership issues a `reconfigure` job.

### Read-Only

- `hub_id` (String) The ID of the hub this network belongs to.
- `id` (String) The unique ID of the SDN network.
- `state` (String) The current state of the network (e.g. `live`).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# SDN networks are imported using their ID.
terraform import cycle_network.shared 651efd54c53f7b6e2c5a9f21
```
